AUTOMATIC RENEWAL TERMS

Effective 1 June 2026. These Automatic Renewal Terms form part of the Subscriber Agreement between you and Wrenfield Audio Labs, Inc. and govern every paid subscription you buy from us.

1. WHAT YOU ARE AGREEING TO

Your subscription renews automatically. When you complete checkout you are enrolling in a recurring subscription that continues until you cancel it. We will charge the payment method you give us at the start of each billing period, without asking you again, until you cancel. You are not required to buy a subscription to use the free tier of the Service.

Before you pay, we show you all of the following on the checkout page, next to the button you press to buy, in the same type size as the surrounding text: the name of the plan, the total recurring charge including tax, the length of each billing period, the date of the first renewal, and a statement that the subscription continues until you cancel. You must tick a separate box that says "I understand my subscription renews automatically until I cancel" before the buy button becomes active. We keep a dated record of that consent for four (4) years and will give you a copy on request.

2. WHAT YOU PAY AND WHEN

The recurring charge is the plan price shown at checkout. Monthly plans renew every month on the calendar day you first subscribed; annual plans renew every year on that date. We charge on the first day of each new billing period.

If we change the recurring charge, we will tell you in writing at least thirty (30) days before the change takes effect. The notice states the old price, the new price, the date the new price first applies, and how to cancel before it does. A price increase never takes effect on a billing period that has already started, and never applies retroactively.

For an annual plan, we send a renewal reminder between forty-five (45) and thirty (30) days before each renewal date. The reminder states the renewal date, the amount we will charge, and a link that cancels the subscription in one step.

3. HOW TO CANCEL

You may cancel at any time, effective at the end of the billing period you are in. Cancelling is one link: sign in, open Billing, and press "Cancel subscription". You do not have to call us, write to us, chat with an agent, answer a survey, or accept an offer to stay. If you bought your subscription through a means other than our website, you may cancel by the same means you used to buy it, and you may also cancel on the website.

We do not require a reason and we do not delay a cancellation you have asked for. If you cancel, we send you an email confirming the cancellation, the date your access ends, and the fact that we will make no further charge, within one (1) business day.

4. WHAT HAPPENS AFTER YOU CANCEL

Your subscription runs to the end of the period you have paid for, and then stops. We make no further charge after that. We do not restart a cancelled subscription without a new affirmative consent from you.

For a monthly plan we do not refund the period in progress. For an annual plan cancelled within thirty (30) days of a renewal charge, we refund that charge in full on request. If we charge you after you have cancelled, tell us and we will refund it within ten (10) business days.

5. FREE TRIALS AND INTRODUCTORY OFFERS

If your subscription starts with a free trial or an introductory price, we tell you at checkout when the trial ends, what you will be charged when it does, and the date of that first charge. We send you a reminder at least three (3) days before a free trial converts to a paid subscription, and at least seven (7) days before an introductory price ends, in each case with a one-step cancellation link. A trial that you cancel before it ends produces no charge.

6. YOUR STATE-LAW RIGHTS

California subscribers. These terms are intended to satisfy California Business and Professions Code sections 17600 to 17606, including the clear-and-conspicuous disclosure, the affirmative consent, the retained record of consent, the online cancellation path for an online enrolment, and the acknowledgement described above.

New York subscribers. These terms are intended to satisfy New York General Business Law section 527-a, including the renewal notice for a subscription with a term of one year or longer.

Nothing in these terms limits any right you have under the federal Restore Online Shoppers' Confidence Act, 15 U.S.C. sections 8401 to 8405, or under the automatic-renewal law of the state where you live. Where a state law gives you more than these terms do, that law applies.

7. HOW WE CHANGE THESE TERMS

We may change these terms. If a change reduces what you get or increases what you pay, we will tell you at least thirty (30) days before it takes effect and you may cancel before it does. A change never applies to a billing period that has already been charged. The current version is always at wrenfieldaudio.example/auto-renewal, and we keep the two most recent prior versions there as well.

8. HOW TO REACH US

Wrenfield Audio Labs, Inc., 1200 Guadalupe Street, Suite 400, Austin, Texas 78701. Email: billing@wrenfieldaudio.example. Telephone: (512) 555-0148, Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm Central. We answer a billing question within one (1) business day.
